title: AN2 Therapeutics, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-09
summary: AN2 Therapeutics, Inc. (ticker: ANTX), a small-cap biotech company listed on Nasdaq Global Select Market, entered into an Open Market Sale Agreement with Jefferies LLC on April 9, 2026, establishing an at-the-market equity offering facility with capacity of up to $80 million in aggregate gross proceeds, with Jefferies earning commissions of up to 3.0%. The company simultaneously terminated its prior ATM facility with TD Cowen under which it had previously sold approximately $20 million of stock.
key_points: AN2 Therapeutics entered into an Open Market Sale Agreement with Jefferies LLC on April 9, 2026 for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $80 million aggregate offering price
Jefferies will act as sales agent with commissions of up to 3.0% of gross proceeds from any sales
The company terminated its prior ATM facility with TD Cowen (assigned to TD Securities) effective April 9, 2026
Under the terminated TD Cowen agreement, the company had sold 2,502,000 shares for aggregate gross proceeds of $20,016,251
The new facility is registered under the company's Form S-3 shelf registration
ANTX trades on Nasdaq Global Select Market; company is classified as an emerging growth company
